description: Tamil Nadu plans to establish integrated AI cities to boost economic growth and create an AI-ready workforce.
body_lead: The Government of Tamil Nadu is evaluating locations for the setting up of an ‘AI city’ that will help the state in harnessing the potential of the technology and drive economic growth. R Kumar, Minister for Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology and Digital Services for the Government of Tamil Nadu, said that rather than just an industrial park, the AI city will function as an integrated ecosystem. It will include AI companies and start-ups, universities and research institutions, Global Capability Centres (GCCs) and Centres for semiconductor and advanced technology research.
